briefing.headline: Soft landing intact as growth holds steady and inflation edges below target.

quotable_numbers.sentence: Core CPI at 2.6 percent for Sep 2026 has cooled near the Fed's target.
Unemployment fell to 4.1 percent for Oct 2026, keeping household income firm.

briefing.whats_new: Today: 10-Year Treasury firmer, from 4.85 percent to 4.94 percent.
